name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative_eq_neg_frame_current
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) ↑f =
        -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent L) f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent_frame_eq_neg_derivative
type:
∀ {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrent L) ⟨(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) u, ⋯⟩ =
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L) u

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_completedFrame_half
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedDerivative L)
      (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame_hasDerivAt
type: ∀ {L σ : ℝ}, 0 < L → σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L) T σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.range_completedFrame
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    (↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2))).range = Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource
type: (L : ℝ) → 0 < L → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource_unique
type:
∀ (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (w : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.generatorDomain L))
  {u : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)},
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) u = ↑w →
    u = (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedSource L hL) w

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.mem_completedFrame_range_iff_ac
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      f ∈ (↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2))).range ↔
        ∃ g, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.HasACDerivative L f g

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame_nativeCompletedSource
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (hx : (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpoint N L) x = 0),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2))
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedSource hL x hx) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.fourierHilbert L x

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent_native_formula
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrentDomain L)),
      (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaCurrent L) f =
        ↑(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaConstant L / 2) • ↑f +
          ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaIntegrand L (↑f) y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_gammaOperator_half
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaDerivative L) (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator_hasDerivAt
type: ∀ {L σ : ℝ}, 0 < L → σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∃ T, HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L) T σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator_half
type:
∀ {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaOperator L (1 / 2) =
      (2 * ↑Real.pi) • Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.volterra L (1 / 2)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients
type: (N : ℕ) → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompleted_weilOperator
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L) =
    -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression N hL +
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCompression N hL))

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCurrent_form
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedCurrentForm L ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) x)
      ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCurrentInclusion N hL) y) =
    inner ℂ x ((Riemann.CCM.Native.weilOperator (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeCompletedCoefficients N L)) y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients N L).beta i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) / Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeGammaCoefficients N L).diagonal i =
    -2 * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaConstant L -
      2 *
        ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L,
          Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaWeight y *
              ((1 - y / L) * Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) - 1) +
            Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.gammaRemainder y

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L b : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients N L b).beta i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, -Real.exp (-b * y) * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y) / Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L b : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativeRealVolterraCoefficients N L b).diagonal i =
    ∫ (y : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 L, 2 * Real.exp (-b * y) * (1 - y / L) * Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * y)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients_beta
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L σ : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients N L σ).beta i =
    ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
      Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n * Real.sin (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * Real.log ↑n) /
        Real.pi

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients_diagonal
type:
∀ (N : ℕ) (L σ : ℝ) (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
  (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.nativePrimeCoefficients N L σ).diagonal i =
    -2 *
      ∑ n ∈ Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeSurvivors L,
        Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeRealWeight σ n * (1 - Real.log ↑n / L) *
          Real.cos (Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L i * Real.log ↑n)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse
type: (L : ℝ) → ℝ → ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L) →L[ℂ] ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.prime_negative_logarithmic_derivative
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  -(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeInverse L σ * Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative L σ) =
    Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCurrent L σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.hasDerivAt_primeOperator
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L) (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeDerivative L σ) σ

name: Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator_euler_product
type:
∀ (L σ : ℝ),
  Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeOperator L σ =
    ↑(∏ p ∈ (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L + 1).primesBelow,
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeCutoff L + 1),
          (Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.primeWeight L σ) p ^ k)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_unitExponential
type:
∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r),
  Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.unitExponential r hr) =
    ↑(Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.laplaceIntegral Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.criticalKernel r) •
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.unitExponential r hr

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completed_laplace_tendsto
type:
Filter.Tendsto (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.laplaceIntegral Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.criticalKernel) Filter.atTop
  (nhds 0)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_not_boundedBelow
type: ¬∃ c, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert), c * ‖f‖ ≤ ‖Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator f‖

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.polarFactor_kills_rawGraphDefect
type:
(ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert - 2 • Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.volterra (3 / 2))
    Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect =
  0

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.norm_completedOperator_le
type: ‖Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator‖ ≤ 8 * Real.pi / 3

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_extends_core
type:
∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.compactSupport),
  Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator ↑f = Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedCore f

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_unique
type:
∀ {T : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert →L[ℂ] ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert},
  (∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.compactSupport), T ↑f = Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedCore f) →
    T = Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_finiteInclusion
type:
∀ (L : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    ∀ (f : ↥(Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.Hilbert L)),
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) f) =
        (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.finiteInclusion L) ((Riemann.Analysis.FiniteWindow.completedFrame L (1 / 2)) f)

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator_supportTruncation_tendsto
type:
∀ (f : ↥Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.Hilbert),
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.supportProjection ↑n)
        (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator ((Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.supportProjection ↑n) f)))
    Filter.atTop (nhds (Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.completedOperator f))

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_nonclosability_witness
type:
∃ f,
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(f n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler (f n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect) ∧
      Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawGraphDefect ≠ 0

name: Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEuler_graphClosure_not_singleValued
type:
¬∀ p ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph,
    ∀ q ∈ closure Riemann.Analysis.HalfLine.rawEulerGraph, p.1 = q.1 → p.2 = q.2

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.corrected
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.shifted
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E →L[ℂ] E

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic
type: {N : ℕ} → ℝ → Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N → ℂ → ℂ

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_at_mode
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (j : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N),
      Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.frequency L j) =
        (-1) ^ Riemann.CCM.Native.mode j * v.ofLp j / ↑√L

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic_outside
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N),
      inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) v = 1 →
        ∀ (k : ℤ),
          (∀ (i : Riemann.CCM.Native.Index N), Riemann.CCM.Native.mode i ≠ k) →
            Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L v ↑(Riemann.CCM.Native.latticeFrequency L k) = 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_nonreal
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {z : ℂ},
  z.im ≠ 0 → Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_eq_integral
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  (z : ℂ),
  Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector z =
    (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L,
        Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector t *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z * (↑t - ↑L / 2))) /
      ↑L

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_boundaryCharacteristic_entire
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  Differentiable ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.boundaryCharacteristic L (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundVector)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.integral_fourierFunction_centered
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {L : ℝ},
  0 < L →
    ∀ (v : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N) (z : ℂ),
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..L, Riemann.CCM.Native.fourierFunction L v t * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * z * (↑t - ↑L / 2)) =
        Riemann.CCM.Native.centeredFourierObservation L v z

type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → ℝ

name: Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData.groundVector
type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ E] → [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData E → E

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) →
    (L : ℝ) →
      0 < L → Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C → Riemann.CCM.FullSimpleEvenData (Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N)

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_ground_bright
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ),
  0 < L → ∀ (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C), inner ℂ (Riemann.CCM.Native.endpointVector N L) A.ground ≠ 0

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_groundWeight_pos
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  0 < (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).groundWeight

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_metric_intertwining
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C),
  (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted ∘SL (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected =
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected ∘SL
      (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).shifted

name: Riemann.CCM.Native.native_corrected_eigenvalue_real
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Riemann.CCM.Native.Coefficients N) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Riemann.CCM.Native.GroundAdmission C)
  {x : Riemann.CCM.Native.Section N} {z : ℂ},
  x ≠ 0 → (Riemann.CCM.Native.fullData C L hL A).corrected x = z • x → z.im = 0
